verdict.rationale: Salv documents a CSV data upload endpoint for bulk historical persons and transactions, plus per-record addPerson/addTransaction endpoints. Its partial-update semantics would let re-sent records upsert safely, but that is only implied. Nothing documents import job status, progress tracking, per-row error reports, or resuming a failed batch. Missing for 10: import job status/progress tracking, per-record failure reporting, documented resume/retry of partially failed imports, idempotency guarantees for bulk uploads, independent corroboration.
